nom: Clinique Redness Solutions Daily Relief Face Cream With Probiotic Technology

avis.texte: I have rosacea that comes and goes to an annoying level. When it's active, my cheeks are so warm and angry. This cools them so nicely. But beyond that - it's just the best cream I've used. I've tried other products over the years but I always keep coming back to this one. It's thick and creamy, absorbs so nicely, has a pleasant scent, and just does the best moisturizing job. It just feels like the best option for me on all aspects. Nothing else has compared.

I was having a rosacea flair up that I have not had in many years. I no longer had my prescriptions for rosacea. I first looked on the Ulta app and found this product. I used this a few times a day for a few days and it helped greatly. I am very happy with this purchase.
I have used this for a long time and now use it night and day...I like it.

avis.titre: The only moisturizer that didn't burn.
avis.texte: I have an outbreak of either rosacea or eczema (app't coming up soon), and every moisturizer I've tried has burned. This Daily Relief Cream does exactly that--brought me relief from the burning. The Soothing Cleanser in this Redness Solutions line did not fare as well. I quickly washed off the cleanser as it burned my skin, and found instant relief when I applied this product.

This is my go to solution for redness on my face. I seem to be allergic to the world, but this lotion works very well for me. Helps calm my irritated skin and seeming to heal it at the same time. I will be a user for life

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: As a redhead with red undertones in my skin, this product balances it all out!
Feels great on skin immediately. Hydrating but didn't make my oily skin oilier.
I was tired of people making comments on my redness. So I figured I'd try it, very disappointed in the result. Especially for the price I paid. It may work for some, but didn't for me.

If you have rosacea try this cream and wash! It is literally the only thing that calmed my rosacea! I look forward ton washing my face and applying the cream! 4 days is all it took (actually first use improved my skin drastically!) if I could submit my picture before and after you would see how amazing this is!

I've been using Clinique products for 30 years. Some of them I like very much and keep using them daily, some of them don't work well on my skin. But it's the first time a product creates an opposite to the expected effect. Instead of reducing the redness, it increases the redness of the skin on my face.
Helps keep my mild rosacea in check while keeping my skin super soft.
This relief cream is wonderful, no burning or itching like others and it does take away some of the redness in my face
I like this stuff a lot, however sometimes it diesnt clear the redness and can cause some redness when applying it. But overall it does work pretty well, you just have to give it a chance!
i have sensitive skin and this made it worse it did not make the redness go away it made me get face blisters and it just did not work for me at all

avis.titre: Just my personal opinion and experience

I bought this cream to counteract the blotchiness and redness on my face, but it doesn't really help. As a moisturizer, it's fine. But even after a generous application, the redness still shows. I was hoping I could go without foundation and just use powder over this cream, but it doesn't work.

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase this product again
avis.texte: It took the redness of my face away. Finally found the right product for my face.

I saw this cream online on ULTA. I went in to get a sample at the Clinique counter. I have red in my face and in one area is my right cheekbone that really stands out more red. I apply my foundation and it covers some what but that cheek bone still shows red. After washing off my makeup I applied the Redness Solution cream. I was amazed in the morning that I could see a difference in my face. My cheek bone was still red but the red was lighter, yep lighter. The rest of my face was better. I have been using it in the morning and no foundation primer. Really it works for me without using a primer. That's because one less step, and at night. I absolutely love this cream. Finally found something that works. Morning I do shave and applying this cream after does not burn nothing, i do not put any other cream on. I wait a few minutes just enough to set up my train case to get ready to my makeup on. Night time I go through removing everything and use my clarifying lotion then apply my Redness cream. Thats it. It doesn't pill on me it's nice cream. It's not greasy. Its been a month now. My foundation looks better and I checked outside and it looks good. That's a plus. I have many points and will use them to buy another jar. Hoping for a sale.
This "moisturizer" is not dry winter skin friendly. In fact, it dried out my skin so much that the texture of my skin changed.

avis.titre: I like the product it takes away the redness
avis.texte: It takes away the redness and calms down the skin. It pairs well with Clinique CC cream for redness.

I am 53 years of age and I've suffered with rosacea since I was 6 years of age. I lived in a small town and was bullied. Growing up we weren't very fortunate with money, so my mum couldn't afford those glamorous creams for me. A couple years back, my daughter bought this for me and it has worked marvelously! It doesn't even take a long time to start working!

avis.titre: Noticed a difference first time using this.
avis.texte: I struggled with finding the right foundation, misjudging the pinkness in my face. The Clinique consultatnt recommended this moisturizer. It counteracts the redness without adding an errie green cast. It is a great moisturizer as well.
I definitely have rosacea and the makeup and moisturizer have not helped or concealed my Rosacea if anything has made it extremely worse.

I had high hopes for this because Clinique is pretty good quality. However, it did not help with my facial redness. I'm pretty sure I have rosacea (never officially diagnosed). Eucerin face lotion and beef tallow work better for my red skin tbh.
this cream has such a rich satisfying feeling, soothes my skin, erases redness, dries quickly; where have you been all my life; i only wish i could buy a huge vat of it for my sensitive skin
It sorta was a little burny the first two days, it does help alot with the redness like it says
This cream pills very badly when rubbing into skin. Even when I have a freshly cleansed and dried face!! It's so disappointing.

avis.titre: Excellent for rosacea and sensitive skin, get it!
avis.texte: This has been a lifesaver for my skin! I've had rosacea and sensitive skin for years. My cheeks would get so red and actually feel like they were burning and I'd never let anyone see me without makeup. Tried so many products. My dermatologist told me stick to a simple routine and don't fall into the fads of multiple products. I started using this after cleansing and using the level 1 toner and after a few days what a difference. I now use it every morning, goes very well under my primer and foundation, and use it every evening. I'll follow with Farmacy Honey Halo at night and on days I'm not wearing makeup. My skin finally feels comfortable and I don't look crazy red all the time. Highly recommend this product. Give it a consistent try if you have red sensitive skin and I hope you get relief like I have. Been using over a year now .

I wanted to love this. I have fair skin and deal with a lot of redness. It gets worse the older I get. The first day I used this product I felt like my face looked fresh, clear. I was so happy. Finally, a product that calmed the redness. I felt like the redness aged me. Over the next few days I noticed that my face was getting beat red. I looked like I had hives. By day 4 my face has itchy and burning. I am so sad. I don't typically react to skin care products like that. I am not sure what could be irritating my skin, but this is definitely causing inflammation. I'm disappointed that it cost this much for me to have recieved that kind of reaction.
I have tried many different facial lotions that don't irritate my skin or cause a burning feeling with my rosacea. This is very light and calming to the face. It has really helped

I have very sensitive skin and redness around my nose and this has changed my skin! Its easy to use right away after washing my face its very light, so it does not clog my pores or leave my face feeling tacky. To see maximum results though, i would recommend using it with the redness relief cc cream by clinique. Havent found anything that works for my skin apart from dermablend in a long time!

avis.titre: Not for me and my rosacea issues
avis.texte: This product actually irritates my rosacea. I purchased this, hoping it would calm the redness on my cheeks but instead, it caused a flareup. I had high hopes for this product, but unfortunately, I will have to keep looking.
I've used it everyday for 1 year and the improvements in my skin are amazing.

avis.titre: Outstanding for my dry, acne, rosacea prone skin!
avis.texte: I cannot recommend this enough if you are dealing with dry, red, sensitive acne and rosacea prone skin! I have been dealing with all of these, and tried sooooo many things and the Redness Solutions line products are the best by far that work very well for me. Love it so much!

I love this moisturizer. It helped soothe my skin and reduced redness along with this line's cleanser within a week. I used this product for about a little over a year. However, I had to quit re-purchasing it due to other financial priorities/having a tighter budget. The only cons for me was: it is way too pricey to keep repurchasing :(

avis.titre: Too expensive, didn't have immediate effect on redness
avis.texte: This was not worth the (very high) cost to me. It was a nice, gentle, moderately thick moisturizer, but it didn't deliver immediate redness reduction, which is what I was hoping for.

Just recently tried this product and it really seems to help tone down the redness in my cheeks and nose. I have very fair skin and a redhead so the redness is REAL! I really appreciate having the redness solutions line and will be trying more products!
This cream is very gentle and really helps reduce redness and blotchiness. It's moisturizing and calming, perfect for sensitive skin.
I buy this every single month. It has done wonders for my mild rosacea

I have never had redness before and I had no idea what it was. First time, I thought I had a skin burn. I had a chance to review "Redness Solutions Cream" while purchasing regular items like moisture cream and sunblock. I ordered "Redness Solutions Daily Relief Cream" and "Daily Protective" instead of getting regular ones, and used them. After one week, all redness is gone. I love them and get them even though I don't have redness anymore. Really works for me and I recommend them for newbies.

avis.titre: Good moisturizer but no effect on redness
avis.texte: I bought the travel set that includes the face wash, moisturizer and sunscreen routine. I was very hopeful it would treat my redness but after 2 months of using it daily twice a day it did nothing for me. the cream moisturizes well and absorbs quickly even though it's very thick but I wouldn't pay this much for just a moisturizing effect with no other benefits.
I have very sensitive skin, and although this is not a redness coverup, it does lessen redness and is so soothing and moisturizing to my very dry skin.

avis.titre: Comodegenic and left me redder than before
avis.texte: I purchased this after having sensitivities to Chanel, La Mer, and Charlotte Tilbury moisturizers. I had determined I am allergic to fragrance mixes. I tried this for a few days and it broke me out. After analyzing ingredients through one of the clean skin sites online, they noted irritants in the list of ingredients which also are comodegenic. I gave my skin a break for a few days, and tried again, controlling for any other factors. Same result. My face clears up when I quit using.

This used to be my holy grail of a moisturizer. It calmed and cleared my skin so well, it was amazing. Over the last year or two I noticed that it wasn't calming my skin, my skin didn't feel hydrated while using it, and it wasn't helping with redness. Turns out hyaluronic acid completely irritates and destroys my skin barrier and I can't use it. Unfortunately this has sodium hyaluronate and I can no longer use it after almost 8 years of using it. I'm so incredibly disappointed since my skin is so sensitive and this was one of the very few products I could use on it.
Was so excited about it! But no, not for me. Having a weird reaction, my face is red, burning and sweating. Trying to wash it off. This is either for you or it is not :)

My skin is extremely sensitive with rosacea and eczema. My face burns and gets red usually midday when the sun is at its peak. I have used several prescriptions from the dermatologist (several I can't use because they burn) and they give minimal results…as well as drugstore creams and lotions. It is difficult for me to find something moisturizing enough that doesn't break me out because on top of my other skin concerns my skin is combination oily/acne prone, it's super fun!!! < not> This product works so well, even though it's priced high I feel like it's really soothed and moisturized my skin better than any other moisturizer, while also not being too heavy. I feel like my skin texture is even changing- it's smoother, the pores are reduced and more even tone. While I still get some redness if it's a really sunny day, it's not as bad and doesn't burn as badly. I'm on the hunt for the best mineral sunscreen to help combat this (chemical sunscreens burn). Currently using the EltaMD UV physical which I love and looks great but going to try something with a higher spf to see if that makes a difference. I hope this review is helpful for anyone else struggling with very sensitive redness-prone skin!!!

I love the soothing nature of this cream. My skin is quite sensitive and prone to redness in some areas. I switch creams from time to time, but I always return to this redness relief cream. This cream works. Side note: my husband likes this cream, too. His skin looks great.

I LOVE Clinique, I am a faithful user of moisture surge and all about eyes, as well as the 7 day scrub for years and years now. I was excited to try this cream because I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea and read great reviews, plus I love Clinique, but unfortunately woke up with tiny little puss white head dots (easily poppable) all over my face in the morning and it turned more red/aggravated. I might be allergic to an ingredient? I wouldn't recommend this if you have acne prone skin!!! I changed nothing else in my routine and haven't had a breakout in over a decade.

avis.titre: Best thing that's happened to my face
avis.texte: This really healed my face. It calmed down a great deal of the redness and dryness due to rosacea. I've been using it everyday for years. It feels cool on my face so it's refreshing. I love it!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: Very pleased with the way it takes the redness out of my cheeks. Softens as well

This face cream is absolutely amazing! It's instantly soothing and calming. I use this after the redness relief cleanser and my face has never felt better. The cream gives me the perfect amount of hydration without being too heavy or causing my face to breakout. I love it and will definitely keep repurchasing!

Based on the reviews I wanted to love this because my face gets so read. After using it for a week I realized it was making the redness worse and also bumpy. Very disappointing, especially for the price.
I have really red cheeks, and this product did not help the redness at all

avis.titre: Love the product, but what is with the 20% price hikes
avis.texte: I do love this product and it started out moderately priced for what it was. Price has gone up 20% every year for the past couple of years. Clinique used to be affordable for all.

I keep coming back to this cream. My skin gets so easily irritated, but this moisturizer calms down the redness and even gets rid of the painful bumps that I've developed from other skincare. This is the perfect rosacea solution. Highly recommend!!

avis.titre: Only thing to get rid of rosacea!
avis.texte: I had tried so many things for rosacea and nothing worked. This is the only thing that worked! I am so thankful because I was so self conscious of my face and now it's completely gone. I definitely recommend this to anyone struggling with rosacea!!!

avis.titre: I see a difference in a short time
avis.texte: This cream is making the red area under my nose look better better after only a few weeks, I will always use twice a day from now on

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again!
avis.texte: I have a small red patch on the side of my nose and part of that cheek, it helps to calm it down. I don't wear much make-up so I love how lite it is.
This lotion is amazing. It doesn't cause breakouts or irritation. It's great for sensitive skin and doesn't have salicylic acid in it. Also works well in winter time with freezing winds.

avis.titre: Reduces the appearance of redness while soothing my skin.
avis.texte: I have persistent redness in my mid-face and chin, a long standing challenge due to diagnosed rosacea. My rosacea is treated periodically by my dermatologist with laser treatments. I am 70 years old and have tried many products for cleansing and soothing my skin, but this product and the associated cleanser have provided the most comfort and reduction in the appearance of redness that I have experienced. This cream is soothing and cooling AND helps to reduce the appearance of redness by morning. If I have a flare, I mix a little of this with Moisture Surge Intense 72 Hr. lipid replenishing hydrator and apply both to areas of redness in the morning under my Moisture Surge Sheer Tinted Hydrator with SPF 25. My skin is comforted and protected.

avis.titre: Works and  you can apply makeup over it easily.
avis.texte: I keep coming back to this product because it works and it dries quickly and is not sticky, greasy, or guppy to the touch. The result is that you can easily apply liquid and powder foundations and makeup over it smoothly. It does not affect the look or feel of your makeup. I have tried many other competitors similar products and they are guppy and affect how your makeup looks. The beauty of this product is that you can use it and wear it every day under your makeup.
This product helps with my rosacea so much!!!! I've been using all the redness solutions products!!! They are awesome!
Love this product! Feels wonderful on irritated skin. Smells great. My dry red areas on my face feel instantly better. Ill be sharing this product with my daughter too! A must have!

Clinique I beg you with all my heart and soul - PLEASE NEVER STOP MAKING THIS!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ I haven't found anything close that works on my Rosacea. I nervously check in every few months to make sure you still have it. It is a thick cream product so a little goes a long way, and in the mornings I mix it with a lighter oil-free moisturizer lotion for all over hydrating coverage. My skin thanks you forever!

avis.titre: Reduces redness and locks in moisture so well
avis.texte: First off, this cream is the only cream I can use without my skin reacting and my skin reacts to everything, even Avene tolerance control cream, which has only like 6 ingredients! This cream reduces redness very well and also moisturizes like a dream, better than cerave cream for flaking skin. It leaves the skin so soft, supple, and smooth and the hydration lasts more than 24 hours. When my skin was flaking due to impaired barrier, it quickly reduces the flaking and stops the stinging and tightness of impaired barrier. I've used this for years and my skin always feel better in this cream.

This is excellent in reducing my redness issues. The ingredients are superior, and the moisturizing benefits and results are outstanding. So glad I found this; it's a keeper! Thank you so much Clinique!
This mostiruzer is my life. maybe even better then some of my friends. absolutely reccomend. even my mom likes it ?!?!!?!!?

avis.titre: Makes break me out so bad
avis.texte: I was very excited about this product because I love all about clinique, but this producto makes me break out so bad with pimples 😩🥲

avis.titre: Love it...so glad I found it!
avis.texte: I have been experiencing red face with heat every evening for hours for over 2 years now. So much so that I now wake up with red cheeks from broken capillaries. I noticed a difference after just one use! It has decreased the amount of red/hot flare ups too but when I do get them if I apply a little of this on the red areas it helps a ton! Still have a little redness in the mornings but this has been going on a while and I've only been using this product for about 2 weeks so I'm sure it will take time but so far so good and Im very pleased!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I truly like the way this product makes my skin feel. It has started to control the redness on my cheeks.

I've been using this maybe a week, and yeah - it absolutely reduces redness. It is ridiculously AMAZING at that part. That said, it feels meh, on my skin. I've fallen in love with the complete beginning to end feel of the Moisture Surge 100H - this Redness Solution is thicker, heavier, less fresh feeling, less cooling, less refreshing - it just doesn't offer that complete pop of refreshed moisture that I love about the moisture surge. But back to the redness - I've never been less red in my life. Definitely works.
I have used Clinique products for 40 years but this one actually made my redness worse. Maybe it is just my skin but I can't recommend this one.
I read a lot of reviews and convinced myself a try! I can see an improvement just after applied 3 times.

I was diagnosed with rosacea acne last month. I have a prescription cream but was curious about the trio that had this, the cleanser, and an SPF thing. THIS caused my face to break out in HIVES. I now have what feels like a burn on the side eof my face that I tested it on. it made the redness worse too.
I havs been diagnosed Rosacea type two. This really worked wow

First and foremost, this did nothing for my redness or rosacea. I'm halfway through the jar and haven't seen any kind of improvement. Putting that aside, it's just an ok moisturizer that isn't doing anything more or less than Cerave or Cetaphil did for my skin. For the price point, I expected more.

avis.titre: Best my skin has ever felt!
avis.texte: I have mild rosacea and have been using Clinique's Redness Solutions Soothing Cleanser for a while but I needed something more to help with dryness. This moisturizer is AMAZING!! My skin has never looked or felt so good. I have even received compliments from complete strangers!

avis.titre: The best, honestly its been the only product that works
avis.texte: 100 percent works for me...rosacea is a hard thing to handle or even figure out. But one thing I know this product is the best ive found.
Great product for a night time solution! Easy to apply. NOT GREASY!!!

So disappointed in this product, plus the fact it cost so much money. It did not cover the redness at all!! Thought I would go with a higher end product I thought would work. Not the case. I ended up purchasing L'Oreal BB Cream Anti-Redness cream. Let me tell you this product works! It covers the redness!! Plus so much cheaper $8.24.

avis.titre: A must if you have rosacea
avis.texte: I started using this product about 2 years ago. At the time, my rosacea was out of control. Once my dermatologist got my meds right, this product calmed my skin down and has kept it calm (if you have rosacea you KNOW what I mean.) I use it day and night and couldn't live without it!
This is not heavy and it keeps my rosacea under control. I use it in am and pm.

I have been using this product for years...then it changed for a while. It honestly felt like it was dramatically different moisturizing lotion with a ton of blue coloring added to it. It was thin and VERY irritating on my sensitive skin. I typically purchase multiple jars at a time and ran into about 4 containers like that. The one I am currently using is the normal cream that I love. I am worried that I may encounter the other with a new purchase! Clinique, we count on you to offer the same products over and over. Don't replace (for a time) with an inferior product! I would rather not purchase than to use that awful stuff again!
Overall great product and has completely helped with rosacea ￼type redness on my face.
What can I say - redness solutions cream is my everyday morning and evening cream. I mix it with 100hrs moisture surge and vitamin C. After applying this coctail my skin feels and looks great.
I've only used the moisturizer for a few days (morning and night) but my redness has already started to go away! I've wanted to try this product for awhile and I'm so glad I did.
This product is the first facial cream I've used that actually works for my sensitive red skin. It helps my skin feel less irritated and appear less red. I use it every day.
I'm always self conscious about my red cheeks. This makes me feel I don't need foundation with a little mascara for a day of light makeup. Great product, definitely recommend!!

This moisturizer deserves a review after using it for 15 years! I started developing an eczema patch on my face at 31yrs. I found this cream and the patch disappeared within days. I have been using this cream ever since. Now that I'm in my mid-40s I use this cream in the morning and an anti-aging cream at night. As soon as I put this cream on in the morning my face instantly feels calmer and moisturized. It's baffling to me how rich and hydrating it is even though it's oil-free. I've been using the Redness Solutions foundation and have been a regular customer ever since. Thank you, Clinique!

avis.titre: Made my husband's ruddy cheeks SO much worse!
avis.texte: So many good reviews, and very few low reviews, so I thought this product would be THE one to finally help my husband's ruddy red cheeks...but after trying this product as a last resort, he will HAVE to go the prescription route now. He's on his second day of using both cleanser and Daily Relief cream and just came to me and showed me how much worse the redness is. He went from a light ruddiness to a DEEP maroon red in the 2 days using this product. There's no itching/burning, but there is a white residue on his cheeks from this cream. He used it very sparingly, so I suppose it COULD be just dry skin, which he didn't have before using! All in all, the wash & cream did nothing to alleviate the redness, but made it noticeably worse! .
I've only been using this for a few days and so far I love it. I have rosacea and I think my cheeks look less inflamed.

According to picture of the redness solutions cream, it's texture is rich and thick. The product I received has very light texture.I have redness and acne on my cheeks and this cream doesn't soothe my skin. It felt a little bit spicy after applying the product on face and there were more breakouts the next day after I using the redness solutions cream. It may not suit people with sensitive skin like me

avis.titre: Works better than my prescription  meds
avis.texte: My dermatologist said to continue with the entire Clinique redness solutions.

I rarely write reviews but I had to with this one. I have been using for approximately 2 years now. And when I don't use it on my face I CAN definitely tell the difference. My face feels tight and I get the redness and the irritated dry patches back. A must have for me!

This cream is really rich and thick. Perfect for when I need that extra moisturizing. Best of all is that it doesn't irritate my skin or make me break out due to allergies. I choose this when my skin is feeling really dry.
I have oily combi skin type and this product was too greasy for me. Also it made my face break out which is very unusual for someone in their sixties.
This cream did nothing for my redness. If anything, it made it worse.
Use this daily to keep my skin calm and rosacea redness to a minimum.
I have used this and related redness relief products by Clinique for over 30 years and love them. They keep my skin soft and greatly reduce visible redness.
I have very dry skin with mild rosacea. Since I started using this twice a day, it has calmed it down and I'm experiencing fewer flare ups. I also use the Redness Solutions cleanser.

I actually purchased this as a recommendation on a Google search figured I would give it a try, as I've tried just about everythinf including prescribed medication. After 3 days I could see a clear difference and my forehead wasn't Rudoplh's red nose. The mid day itching stopped and I could see a difference. I use all three, missed one day since use but it didn't hinder anything. Going into summer I needed this and I am glad I found this little jem.

I think it would probably work for people that have normal skin but it made my face break out after one use. I have sensitive skin & Clinique usually doesn't break my face out but it's a pretty heavy product.

I rarely post reviews, but this formula has been a lifesaver. I recently started getting rosacea on my face. I've tried a lot of products before landing on this product. I use this in conjunction with the Redness Solutions Soothing Cleanser. I have been using these as directed 2x a day for the past 5 days, and I am astonished by the result. I wish I would have taken a before picture, but this product is amazing, and does actually work.

avis.titre: It Helps If You Know Why You Have Redness
avis.texte: This is one of the rare Clinique misses for me, but I think it's my fault. It turns out I don't have rosacea, but just very dry skin that was in need of hydration and moisture. So for me, this cream is just a moisturizer. It works well enough, but I like several other Clinique moisturizers better. I'd recommend you get a diagnosis from a dermatologist or consult with a Clinique advisor before buying this cream if you aren't sure you have rosacea.

The Redness Solutions cream soothes my skin and did not make it worse as other products (including a prescription) have done. The 15 SPF sunscreen is an excellent facial sun block. The cleanser does not leave my skin feeling clean so I use that only sparingly. I spent about $50 on the starter kit with these three products which is more cost effective than trying less costly products that do not work.

I am truly blown away by this moisturizer. I put it on before work and just threw on some mascara. My skin was so even, no redness peeking through, that I could barely believe it was just my skin and no foundation. The NEXT day, my boyfriend even asked me if I was wearing makeup because my skin looked so even! No redness! This is a game changer, especially for this hot weather that usually makes my redness so much worse.

I found out last year after a horrible summer that I have Rosecea, genetics that permanently makes my cheeks sensitive and red. This stuff has greatly reduced it's severity and red bumps. After I use up this product I'll consider the whole set.

i have a lot of redness, bordering on rosacea. i tried the cetaphil ant-redness regimine for about a week and noticed some change in skin clarity. clinique's turn: two nights of this stuff…Two Nights…i glanced in the mirror and was shocked! enough of a difference in my skin that it literally shocked me! i think i found my cure.
While its on the pricey side, I find that this moisturizer really targets the redness in my t-zone better than other moisturizers I've tried. I've always gone back to this product time and again.
